beats.text: She lived nearer to the Moon landing.
beats.note: The Great Pyramid was already about 2,500 years old when she was born. Apollo 11 was only about 2,000 years ahead of her. To Cleopatra, the pyramids were ancient history.

beats.name: The Great Pyramid of Giza
beats.role: Finished for the pharaoh Khufu. By the time Cleopatra ruled Egypt it had already stood for roughly 2,500 years: older to her than she is to us.

beats.note: Her family, the Ptolemies, descended from a Macedonian general of Alexander the Great, and ruled Egypt for three centuries while speaking only Greek.

beats.text: She was said to be the first of her line to bother learning Egyptian.

beats.line: The pyramids were ancient long before Cleopatra was born.
